stem: Which fact in the selection is best supported by the last photograph?

options.label: F
options.text: Acorn weevils are the first insects to live in acorns.

options.label: G
options.text: Acorn weevil larvae eat the inside of the acorn.

options.label: H
options.text: Acorn weevils can use their snouts to drill holes in acorns.

options.label: J
options.text: Acorn weevil larvae are inside an acorn when it falls from the tree.
